definitions.gloss: reading through; reading from beginning to end
definitions.explanation: Reading a text, book, or document in its entirety from start to finish, as opposed to skimming, sampling, or reading selected portions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通読|つうどく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I read this book from cover to cover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通読|つうどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦サインした→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧。
examples.english: I read through the contract before signing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{通読|つうどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧めったにいない。
examples.english: Very few people read a dictionary from beginning to end.

notes:
Emphasizes completeness — reading every part of a text without skipping. Often used when describing a thorough or disciplined approach to reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{通読|つうどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to read through in one sitting
- ⟦{全巻|ぜんかん}→全巻：17073_zenkan⟧{通読|つうどく} — reading through all volumes
- {通読|つうどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値|あたい}する→値する：25545_ataisuru⟧ — worth reading through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精読|せいどく}→精読：15982_seidoku⟧ — close reading, careful reading (focuses on depth of comprehension)
- ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧ — speed reading (focuses on reading quickly)
- ⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧ — extensive reading (reading large quantities)
- ⟦{拾|ひろ}い{読|よ}み→拾い読み：17927_hiroiyomi⟧ — selective reading, reading bits and pieces (the opposite approach)
